title: Kenyan Trout Tacos
description: A fusion of traditional Kenyan and Mexican flavors, this dish features pan-seared trout served in a crispy taco shell.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the trout fillets with cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Add a small amount of oil to the skillet and sear the trout for 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Heat the stew tomatoes in a separate skillet over medium heat.
Add the rainbow peppers to the skillet with the stew tomatoes and cook until tender.
Slice the cooked trout into small pieces and add to the skillet with the peppers and stew tomatoes.
Stir in the nutty almonds and cook for an additional minute.
Assemble the tacos by placing a portion of the trout mixture onto a warmed tortilla and topping with a dollop of sour cream and a squeeze of lime juice.
